messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Neon Pairs is built. Open the self-contained [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html) directly to play offline.

The implementation includes board codes, snapshot export and import, saved size and best scores, and the replay CLI. The locked install, type check, build, unit tests and browser checks passed. The browser checks include offline play, a complete keyboard game, snapshot pause and resume, and large-board navigation.

No screen reader or real-device touch long press was tested; those remain user acceptance checks.
